c1.excerpt:
The powers — knowledge, memory, removal — have been established. But a power needs a support, and the
question is what supports them. Kārikā 1 gives the support's own form in the image of the pratibhā:
the flashing that runs through the ordered word-objects, seasoned with their order, touched by it —
but itself not ordered. Its support is therefore not anything ordered, but the order-less,
infinite-consciousness-form knower. And that knower is the great Lord.
